name: Adobe Firefly
description: Adobe Firefly Services provides generative and editing APIs for images and video, including text-to-image generation, generative fill and expand, compositing, upscaling, and asynchronous media jobs.
agentUseSummary: Firefly exposes paid generative operations rather than a useful read-only data surface and requires enterprise provisioning through an Adobe representative and Developer Console product profile. Relay mounts no credentials or generation tools until a customer entitlement, spend and rate budget, content policy, output-storage lifecycle, and bounded model/action contract are approved.

blocked.label: Connect Adobe Firefly
blocked.description: No reviewed enterprise entitlement, spend limit, content policy, and output lifecycle contract exists.

blocked.label: Generate Firefly media
blocked.description: Image and video generation, fill, expand, composite, similar, and upscale operations are unavailable.

blocked.label: Manage Firefly jobs and assets
blocked.description: Uploads, job polling, generated outputs, custom models, storage, downloads, and administration are unavailable.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No generative action can be enabled without an enterprise, spend, safety, storage, and bounded API contract.

runtimeSupport.description: No Firefly tools are mounted without an approved enterprise generation contract.
No Firefly tools are mounted without an approved enterprise generation contract.

providerSetup.blocker: Firefly API access requires an enterprise customer provisioned through Adobe, and its useful surface consists of metered generative media operations with asynchronous jobs and external input/output storage rather than harmless reads.
providerSetup.nextAction: An authorized enterprise customer records its Firefly entitlement and commercial limits, then approves a maximum spend/rate budget, allowed models and operations, prompt/content policy, input-domain and upload policy, output retention/download lifecycle, Content Credentials handling, audit fields, and per-generation approval semantics before Relay implements customer-owned OAuth server-to-server credentials.

evidence.supports: Adobe states enterprise customers need assigned Admin Console roles and Firefly product access, and documents customer-owned OAuth server-to-server credentials and product profiles.
Adobe's API reference exposes generative image/video, alteration, fill, expand, similar, composite, upload, upscale, and asynchronous operations rather than a useful customer-data read surface.
Adobe documents organization-level request limits, account-manager escalation, asynchronous Image Model 5 jobs, size limits, and restricted external storage domains.
Adobe documents fixed IMS client-credentials authentication, customer client ID/secret handling, Firefly scopes, and 24-hour access tokens.
